Name: Partner Invite
Subject: {first}, quick in-person exam opportunity in {place}

I'm lining up a small group of partner proctors in the {place} area who'd like another source of income. Here's how it works:

- Students buy a self-study package from us and prepare on their own with our SafePrep app.
- When they're ready, they can choose an in-person exam instead of taking it online through ProctorU.
- When a student near you picks in-person, we send them your way.
- You proctor only. No teaching or prep. The student shows up ready to test.
- We buy the exam code and handle the student's payment. You don't front anything.
- You earn $50 per student. You and the student pick where to meet.

Students choose a partner over a testing center because you go to them. {link:la-page}

No minimums, and you can drop out anytime.
